notes: Both 'that's are added: each antecedent is written and the Hebrew relative clauses are asyndetic, so rule 46's headless case does not reach them and rule 55 governs.
They are two added units rather than one, since the ASV's own rendered material stands between the runs (rule 2).
The margin's Hebrew gloss 'draweth forth' was read and set aside (rule 38).
